selection_rule: Within each saved and documented candidate set, for each project and semantic change class, take the latest two qualifying merged changes by merged_at after excluding bots, docs-only, generated-only, backports, test-only, CI-only, and performance-only changes. Because at least four of each project's six base changes had sequence-unknown evidence, add the next qualifying change in every class, for nine changes per project.

sequence_labels.test-first-visible-with-failure-confirma: A test-only commit precedes its implementation commit and a contemporaneous source confirms that pre-fix test failed.
sequence_labels.test-first-visible-without-failure-confi: A test-only commit precedes the relevant implementation commit, but no surviving CI or author report confirms the test failed at that point.
sequence_labels.same-commit-unknown: The first relevant commit contains both implementation and test changes; Git cannot reveal local authoring order.
sequence_labels.implementation-then-test-commits: A relevant implementation-only commit precedes the test commit. This is repository commit order, not proof of the author's local editing order.
sequence_labels.existing-tests-only: No relevant test file changed; available CI exercises existing checks or the change relies on non-automated validation.
sequence_labels.insufficient-history: Available history cannot resolve the relevant file or commit sequence.

limitations: GitHub Search returned HTTP 422 for facebook/react date queries, so React candidates use the repository's official Pulls API and are sorted locally by merged_at.
Candidate endpoints are capped at 100 items per saved page. The saved lists are the actual inspected candidate sets, not a claim of a complete two-year census.
GitHub check-runs endpoints are capped to the fetched first 100 runs in large React and Next.js suites; CI snapshots support only bounded status claims.
PR/MR commit history can be rebased, force-pushed, squashed, or amended before merge and never exposes uncommitted local editing order.
